# chatgpt.ge - Comprehensive AI Knowledge Base

## Overview & Mission
chatgpt.ge is the primary educational portal for Generative AI in Georgia. The initiative bridges the gap between frontier artificial intelligence technology and practical daily workflows for professionals, executives, and enterprise teams.

## 1. Flagship Course: "AI - Generative Intelligence in Practice"
- **Location:** Tbilisi, Georgia (Online & Blended)
- **Duration:** 11 Lectures (Interactive presentations, homework assignments, case studies)
- **Language:** Georgian (technical terms preserved in English)
- **Prerequisites:** No programming background required. Designed for all knowledge workers.
- **Certification:** Official Certificate of Completion issued upon passing assignments.

### Detailed Lecture Curriculum
- **Lecture 1: Introduction to Generative AI & Frontier Models:** Architecture overview (Transformers, LLMs), prompt anatomy, temperature and top_p, ethical considerations, security guardrails.
- **Lecture 2: Advanced Prompt Engineering:** Few-shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), role-based conditioning, Markdown formatting, output constraints.
- **Lecture 3: Deep Research & Fact-Checking:** Perplexity AI, Pro Search, Google Scholar integration, citation validation, hallucination mitigation.
- **Lecture 4: Writing, Editing & Creative Direction:** Long-form synthesis, tone matching, multi-language translation, Claude vs ChatGPT comparative strengths.
- **Lecture 5: Data Analysis, Sheets & Visualizations:** Advanced Data Analysis (Code Interpreter), CSV/Excel analysis, chart generation, automated reporting.
- **Lecture 6: AI Image Generation & Visual Prompting:** Midjourney, Flux.1, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 3, aspect ratios, style consistency, inpainting.
- **Lecture 7: Audio & Voice AI:** ElevenLabs text-to-speech, Georgian voice models, voice cloning, Suno/Udio music composition, podcast cleaning.
- **Lecture 8: AI Video & Digital Avatars:** HeyGen, Runway Gen-2/Gen-3, Pika Labs, script-to-video pipelines, virtual presenters.
- **Lecture 9: No-Code Automation & Workflows:** Make.com scenario building, webhook triggers, API integrations, multi-app synchronization.
- **Lecture 10: Custom GPTs & Personal AI Assistants:** System instructions, knowledge file retrieval (RAG), custom Actions (OpenAPI specifications).
- **Lecture 11: Enterprise AI Strategy & Future Frontiers:** ROI measurement, organizational AI policies, agentic workflows, autonomous systems.

---

## 2. Corporate AI Training Programs (B2B)
Designed to accelerate organizational productivity by an average of 40% while cutting task completion time by up to 60%.

### Training Tiers
1. **AI Awareness (2-4 Hours):** Executive masterclass for C-level leaders and department heads focusing on AI strategy, ROI, risk governance, and legal/ethics compliance.
2. **AI Essentials (6-8 Hours):** Hands-on team training covering daily workflow automation, departmental prompt engineering, and core AI productivity tools.
3. **AI Professional (10-12+ Hours):** Deep-dive custom integration incorporating company-specific data pipelines, custom assistant development, and complex workflow automation.

### Industry-Tailored Tracks
- **Education & Academia:** Curriculum design, automated assessment rubrics, personalized student feedback, research synthesis.
- **Construction & Architecture:** Regulatory compliance analysis, tender proposal drafting, project schedule risk evaluation, visual concept iteration.
- **Retail & E-Commerce:** Product description automation, customer service sentiment analysis, inventory forecasting assistance.
- **Logistics & Supply Chain:** Route optimization planning, vendor communication templates, tracking summaries.
- **Hospitality & HoReCa:** Multi-language guest communication, review responses, menu localization, marketing content.
- **Media & Communications:** News briefing generation, social media adaptation, video clipping, press releases.
